get.description: Transient SSE transport with canonical {data,meta} JSON frames, UTC occurredAt, event IDs, initial stream.connected, retry3000 and heartbeat15seconds. Strict no-query contract. Last-Event-ID does not provide replay; fetch canonical resources on reconnect. Public ORBAT stream preserves anonymous access and calendar fields, discards staff events and actor/private payload fields. Protected streams require live session/bot and scope permissions, revalidated on every delivered event and heartbeat; revocation or required audit failure closes stream. Profile events require self or allowed staff hierarchy; inbox owner/superadmin; training request owner/training staff; promotion queue rank:manage_promotions; catalog scoped create/edit/delete. Only minimal event metadata is delivered, with returned other-user target reads audited before delivery. Abort, cancellation, errors and queue/backpressure limits release listeners/timers.
